We've prepared the dates of the events our team is planning for this year. Of course everything depends on the easing of current restrictions – camps and day camps will be possible with at least 10 riders / participants, or ideally the planned 20.

We know that big events like Říčanské Šlapačky are really up in the air, but smaller sports-focused events should have a better chance of success. Unfortunately we've had to cut back our plans for camps in Moravia, but we've added a few dates of classic one-day camps, which we'll expand with different levels and locations on the trails.

We once again want to pass on some of our knowledge of technical riding and the pump track to learning-hungry women – and, for 2021, to their male counterparts too.

Due to great success we're also planning kids' day camps focused on MTB and the pump track.

We'll publish the camp programme, prices and other details as soon as possible.
